env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A union member that is an alias for a pointer to an accessible alias of
# an unexported decoder type decodes through the accessible spelling: the
# trial allocates new(lib.Public), not new(lib.hidden), which the holder
# package cannot name. The inverse member is an exported pointer alias
# that wraps a private alias of an exported decoder: the trial allocates
# new(lib.InverseValue), not new(lib.inverseAlias), which the holder
# package cannot name.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^ok ptr 11$'
stdout '^ok inverse 12$'
-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/unionaliasptr

go 1.27
-- good/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
)

type hidden struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
}

func (h *hidden) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	var m map[string]int64
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &m); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	v, ok := m["x"]
	if !ok {
		return errors.New("hidden requires x")
	}
	h.X = v
	return nil
}

type Public = hidden

type Ptr = *Public

type InverseValue struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
}

func (v *InverseValue) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	var m map[string]int64
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &m); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	x, ok := m["x"]
	if !ok {
		return errors.New("InverseValue requires x")
	}
	v.X = x
	return nil
}

type inverseAlias = InverseValue

type InversePtr = *inverseAlias
-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/unionaliasptr/lib"
)

type Other struct {
	Y string `json:"y"`
}

func (o *Other) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	var m map[string]string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &m); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	v, ok := m["y"]
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("Other requires y")
	}
	o.Y = v
	return nil
}

type U interface {
	lib.Ptr | *Other
}

type H struct {
	Item U `json:"item"`
}

type U2 interface {
	lib.InversePtr | *Other
}

type H2 struct {
	Item U2 `json:"item"`
}

func main() {
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"x":11}}`), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("decode err:", err)
		return
	}
	if p, ok := h.Item.(lib.Ptr); ok {
		fmt.Println("ok ptr", p.X)
	} else {
		fmt.Printf("WRONG TYPE %T\n", h.Item)
		return
	}
	var h2 H2
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"x":12}}`), &h2); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("decode err:", err)
		return
	}
	if p, ok := h2.Item.(lib.InversePtr); ok {
		fmt.Println("ok inverse", p.X)
		return
	}
	fmt.Printf("WRONG TYPE %T\n", h2.Item)
}
